ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated in a large contiguous mass surrounding the median notch and extending along the proximal trailing edges, with numerous dark linear and punctate marks overlaying the white sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 75-80 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 20% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary, with peak amplitudes varying between 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed along the trailing edges, tapering to pointed tips oriented upwards and outwards.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, high-contrast pixel clusters and irregular textures visible at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation; multiple prominent intersecting tracks are located on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear scarring across both lobes consistent with rake marks; multiple irregular notches and jagged disruptions along the trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct intersecting 'X' pattern formed by linear scars located in the center-left white region.
